web.social.alerts.commented.note: Alerts section: an alert about a friend. {name} is the friend's name (bold, <b>).

web.social.alerts.friend_accepted.note: Alerts section: an alert about a friend. {name} is the friend's name (bold, <b>).

web.social.alerts.friend_request.note: Alerts section: an alert about a friend. {name} is the friend's name (bold, <b>).

web.social.alerts.friends.note: Alerts section: beside a friend request accepted from here. Keep the check mark.

web.social.alerts.liked_comment.note: Alerts section: an alert about a friend. {name} is the friend's name (bold, <b>).

web.social.alerts.liked_post.note: Alerts section: an alert about a friend. {name} is the friend's name (bold, <b>).

web.social.alerts.more.note: Alerts section: after an error alert's title, how many more errors it groups ({more}); hovering shows them all.

web.social.alerts.nothing.note: Alerts section: when there are no alerts.

web.social.comment.author.note: Social feed: before a comment's text, who wrote it. {name} is their name. Keep or change the colon as your language writes it.

web.social.comment.confirm_delete.note: Social feed: confirmation before deleting a comment.

web.social.comment.delete.note: Social feed: tooltip of the bin button on a comment you can delete (on your post, or your own).

web.social.comment.like.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the heart button on a comment you haven't liked.

web.social.comment.me.note: Social feed: the author shown on your own comment for the moment it takes to send it. Lowercase in English.

web.social.comment.placeholder.note: Social feed: placeholder of the field under a post for writing a comment.

web.social.comment.post.note: Social feed: button that sends the comment written. A verb.

web.social.comment.unlike.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the heart button on a comment you liked.

web.social.composer.camera.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): button (on phones and tablets) that opens the camera. A camera symbol comes before it.

web.social.composer.caption.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): placeholder of the caption field (every post needs one).

web.social.composer.drop.text: Drag photos or videos here, or click to choose files from this computer.
web.social.composer.drop.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): the box that takes photos and videos from this computer.

web.social.composer.library.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): tab that picks photos and videos from the device.

web.social.composer.move_earlier.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): accessibility name of the ‹ button under an item of the strip. {name} is its name or path.

web.social.composer.move_later.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): accessibility name of the › button under an item of the strip. {name} is its name or path.

web.social.composer.order.text: Order in post — drag, or use ‹ ›
web.social.composer.order.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): title of the strip showing the post's photos in order. ‹ and › are the buttons that move one; keep them.

web.social.composer.publish.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): button that publishes the post.

web.social.composer.publish_count.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): button that publishes the post. {count} is how many photos and videos it has.

web.social.composer.publish_failed.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): error when the device didn't publish the post and gave no reason of its own.

web.social.composer.publishing.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): on the Publish button while the post is sent.

web.social.composer.remove_file.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): accessibility name of the × on a photo or video taken from this computer. {name} is its file name.

web.social.composer.remove_from_post.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): accessibility name of the × on an item of the strip. {name} is its name or path.

web.social.composer.remove_tag.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): accessibility name of the × on a tag filter. {tag} is the tag (beach).

web.social.composer.tag_filter.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): placeholder of the field that filters the library by tag.

web.social.composer.this_computer.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): tab that picks photos and videos from this computer.

web.social.composer.title.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): its title.

web.social.composer.trim.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): badge on a video in the strip; opens the trimmer. Keep the scissors.

web.social.composer.trim_item.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): accessibility name of a video in the strip; opens the trimmer. {name} is the video's name or path.

web.social.composer.trim_load_failed.text: Could not load that video to trim it.
web.social.composer.trim_load_failed.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): error when a video from the device couldn't be fetched to trim it.

web.social.composer.upload_none.text: Could not upload any of the selected files.
web.social.composer.upload_none.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): error when none of the files from this computer could be sent to the device.

text.one: {count} file(s) failed to upload - publishing the rest.
text.other: {count} file(s) failed to upload - publishing the rest.

web.social.composer.upload_some.note: New post (the composer opened from the + button): when some files from this computer couldn't be sent; the post goes out with the rest. {count} is how many failed.

web.social.feed.empty_text.text: Share a photo or a video with your friends — it goes from your device to theirs, with no cloud in between.
web.social.feed.empty_text.note: Social feed: text under No social posts, above the button that starts a new post.

web.social.feed.empty_title.note: Social feed: title when there are no posts yet.

web.social.feed.loading_more.note: Social feed: at the end of the feed while older posts load.

web.social.feed.new_post.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the big + button that starts a new post when there are none.

web.social.feed.user.note: Social feed: the name shown for someone whose profile has no name (on a post, a comment or the photo viewer).

web.social.friends.add_title.note: Friends section: title of the box that sends a friend request.

web.social.friends.ask_delete_mine.text: Ask {name}'s device to delete what I shared there
web.social.friends.ask_delete_mine.note: Friends section: tick box when removing a friend. {name} is the friend's name.

web.social.friends.ask_delete_mine_hint.text: Your posts, comments and likes on their device. If it's offline, it happens the next time it connects; until then they show as leaving.
web.social.friends.ask_delete_mine_hint.note: Friends section: small text under the tick box that asks the friend's device to delete what you shared.

web.social.friends.asked_delete.text: Asked their device to delete what you shared
web.social.friends.asked_delete.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, once a friend was removed and their device asked to delete your posts, comments and likes.

web.social.friends.block.note: Friends section: button that blocks a friend or a request.

web.social.friends.cancel_request.note: Friends section: button that withdraws a friend request you sent.

web.social.friends.confirm_cancel.note: Friends section: asked before withdrawing a friend request you sent.

web.social.friends.confirm_delete.note: Friends section: asked before deleting a friend request you received.

web.social.friends.confirm_remove_now.text: Remove {name} now? This stops waiting for their device. Whatever it hasn't deleted yet stays there.
web.social.friends.confirm_remove_now.note: Friends section: confirmation of Remove now. {name} is the friend's name.

web.social.friends.delete_error.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the deletion of a request couldn't be sent.

web.social.friends.delete_failed.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the device didn't delete a request.

web.social.friends.delete_theirs.text: Also delete everything from {name} on this device
web.social.friends.delete_theirs.note: Friends section: tick box when removing a friend. {name} is the friend's name.

web.social.friends.delete_theirs_hint.text: Their posts and photos, and their comments and likes on any post.
web.social.friends.delete_theirs_hint.note: Friends section: small text under the tick box Also delete everything from them on this device: what gets deleted.

web.social.friends.friends_again.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the request went to someone who already had you as a friend.

web.social.friends.invalid_name.text: Enter the device's name, like pit - letters, digits and dashes.
web.social.friends.invalid_name.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the name typed isn't a device name. pit is an example of a device name; keep it.

web.social.friends.keep.note: Friends section: button that leaves the friendship or request as it is, instead of deleting or removing it.

web.social.friends.leaving.note: Friends section: the state of a friendship, on a pill beside the friend: a friend removed, whose device hasn't deleted what you shared yet.

web.social.friends.name_label.note: Friends section: accessibility name of the field for a friend's device name. {suffix} is the fixed end of every device's address (off-the.cloud).

web.social.friends.name_placeholder.note: Friends section: placeholder of the field for a friend's device name (the part before .off-the.cloud). Lowercase in English.

web.social.friends.no_domain.note: Friends section: in place of a friend's device address when it is unknown.

web.social.friends.no_name.note: Friends section: in place of a friend's name when their profile has none.

web.social.friends.no_others.note: Friends section: when the only friendships are requests waiting for your answer.

web.social.friends.none.note: Friends section: when there are no friends or requests.

web.social.friends.remove.note: Friends section: button that removes a friend (opens the options), and the button that confirms it.

web.social.friends.remove_error.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the removal couldn't be sent.

web.social.friends.remove_failed.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the device refused to remove a friend and gave no reason of its own.

web.social.friends.remove_now.note: Friends section: button beside a leaving friend that stops waiting for their device and removes them.

web.social.friends.removed.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, once a friend was removed.

web.social.friends.request_cancelled.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, once a friend request you sent was withdrawn.

web.social.friends.request_deleted.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, once a friend request you received was deleted.

web.social.friends.request_failed.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the device refused a friend request and gave no reason of its own.

web.social.friends.request_sent.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, once a friend request was sent.

web.social.friends.send.note: Friends section: button that sends a friend request.

web.social.friends.send_error.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when a friend request couldn't be sent.

web.social.friends.sending.note: Friends section: on the Send request button while the request is sent.

web.social.friends.set_pending.note: Friends section: button that puts a friendship back to pending (not accepted, not blocked).

web.social.friends.status_accepted.note: Friends section: the state of a friendship, on a pill beside the friend: you are friends.

web.social.friends.status_accepted_sent.note: Friends section: the state of a friendship, on a pill beside the friend: you sent the request and they accepted it.

web.social.friends.status_blocked.note: Friends section: the state of a friendship, on a pill beside the friend: you blocked them.

web.social.friends.status_blocked_sent.note: Friends section: the state of a friendship, on a pill beside the friend: you sent the request and they blocked it.

web.social.friends.status_pending.note: Friends section: the state of a friendship, on a pill beside the friend: a request nobody has answered yet.

web.social.friends.status_pending_sent.note: Friends section: the state of a friendship, on a pill beside the friend: you sent the request and they haven't answered.

web.social.friends.status_updated.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, once a friendship was accepted, blocked or set to pending.

web.social.friends.title.note: Friends section: title of the list of friends.

web.social.friends.unexpected.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the device answered with something unexpected.

web.social.friends.update_error.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when a friendship's change couldn't be sent.

web.social.friends.update_failed.note: Friends section: message shown for a moment at the top, when the device refused to change a friendship and gave no reason of its own.

web.social.friends.waiting_delete.text: Waiting for their device to delete what you shared.
web.social.friends.waiting_delete.note: Friends section: beside a friend removed whose device hasn't deleted your posts, comments and likes yet.

web.social.friends.waiting_title.note: Friends section: title of the friend requests waiting for you to accept, block or delete them.

web.social.friends.yes.note: Friends section: button that confirms cancelling or deleting a friend request.

web.social.likes.none.note: Social feed: in the list of who liked a post or a comment, when nobody has.

web.social.likes.title.note: Social feed: title of the list of who liked a post or a comment.

web.social.post.confirm_delete.note: Social feed: confirmation before deleting one of your own posts (it is deleted on your friends' devices too).

web.social.post.delete.note: Social feed: tooltip of the bin button on one of your own posts.

web.social.post.download_photo_position.note: Social feed: the download button under a post saves the photo or video shown (the copy made for the post): its tooltip, on a post with several. {index} is the photo's position and {total} how many the post has.

web.social.post.download_video_position.note: Social feed: the download button under a post saves the photo or video shown (the copy made for the post): its tooltip, on a post with several. {index} is the video's position and {total} how many the post has.

web.social.post.label_photo.note: Social feed: the download button under a post saves the photo or video shown (the copy made for the post): its accessibility name, on a post with one photo.

web.social.post.label_photo_position.note: Social feed: the download button under a post saves the photo or video shown (the copy made for the post): its accessibility name, on a post with several. {index} is the photo's position and {total} how many the post has.

web.social.post.label_video.note: Social feed: the download button under a post saves the photo or video shown (the copy made for the post): its accessibility name, on a post with one video.

web.social.post.label_video_position.note: Social feed: the download button under a post saves the photo or video shown (the copy made for the post): its accessibility name, on a post with several. {index} is the video's position and {total} how many the post has.

web.social.post.like.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the heart button under a post you haven't liked.

web.social.post.likes.note: Social feed: under a post; opens the list of who liked it. {count} is how many likes.

web.social.post.mute.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the speaker button on a video playing with sound.

web.social.post.next.note: Social feed: tooltip of the button that shows the next photo or video of a post.

web.social.post.next_item.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the button that shows the next photo or video of a post (over a video).

web.social.post.previous.note: Social feed: tooltip of the button that shows the previous photo or video of a post.

web.social.post.previous_item.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the button that shows the previous photo or video of a post (over a video).

web.social.post.replay.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the button that plays a video again once it ended.

web.social.post.share_unavailable.note: Social feed: message after pressing Share under a post; sharing a post isn't possible yet.

web.social.post.unlike.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the heart button under a post you liked.

web.social.post.unmute.note: Social feed: accessibility name of the speaker button on a muted video.

web.social.profile.avatar.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): description of the profile picture when the profile has no name. Lowercase in English.

web.social.profile.bio.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): placeholder of the field for a few words about yourself.

web.social.profile.from_computer.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): button that picks a new profile picture from this computer.

web.social.profile.from_device.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): button that picks a new profile picture from the photos on the device.

web.social.profile.load_failed.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): error when the device couldn't load the profile and gave no reason of its own.

web.social.profile.name.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): placeholder of the name field.

web.social.profile.no_bio.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): the card visitors see, when the profile has no text about its owner.

web.social.profile.save.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): button that saves the profile.

web.social.profile.save_failed.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): error when the device didn't save the profile and gave no reason of its own.

web.social.profile.saved.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): message once the profile was saved.

web.social.profile.saving.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): on the save button while the profile is saved.

web.social.profile.unexpected.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): error when the device answered with something else than the profile.

web.social.profile.unnamed.note: Profile (your public profile in Settings, and the card visitors see): the card visitors see, when the profile has no name.

web.social.time.days.note: Alerts: an alert's time when it is less than a week old. {days} is how many days. Shortest form (d for days).

web.social.time.days_ago.note: Social feed: a post's date when it is less than a week old. {days} is how many days. Short form (d for days).

web.social.time.hours.note: Alerts: an alert's time when it is less than a day old. {hours} is how many hours. Shortest form (h for hours).

web.social.time.hours_ago.note: Social feed: a post's date when it is less than a day old. {hours} is how many hours. Short form (h for hours).

web.social.time.just_now.note: Social feed and Alerts: when a post or an alert is less than a minute old, in place of its date. Lowercase in English.

web.social.time.minutes.note: Alerts: an alert's time when it is less than an hour old, after the alert's text. {minutes} is how many minutes. Shortest form (m for minutes).

web.social.time.minutes_ago.note: Social feed: a post's date when it is less than an hour old. {minutes} is how many minutes. Short form (m for minutes).

web.social.viewer.download_photo.note: Social feed: tooltip of the download button in the photo viewer, and under a post with one photo; it saves the copy made for the post.

web.social.viewer.download_video.note: Social feed: tooltip of the download button in the photo viewer, and under a post with one video; it saves the copy made for the post.

web.social.viewer.full.note: Social feed's photo viewer: description of the photo shown full size. Lowercase in English.

web.social.viewer.photo_by.note: Social feed's photo viewer: its accessibility name. {name} is who posted it.

web.social.viewer.photo_by_position.note: Social feed's photo viewer: its accessibility name, on a post with several. {name} is who posted it, {index} the photo's position, {total} how many the post has.

web.social.viewer.video_by.note: Social feed's photo viewer: its accessibility name, on a video. {name} is who posted it.

web.social.viewer.video_by_position.note: Social feed's photo viewer: its accessibility name, on a video of a post with several. {name} is who posted it, {index} the video's position, {total} how many the post has.

web.social.viewer.video_loading.note: Social feed's photo viewer: description of a video's still picture shown while the video loads. Lowercase in English.
